name: Leucine-catabolism organic acidemias and biotin cycle defects
rationale: Members are inborn errors of branched-chain (mainly leucine) acyl-CoA catabolism plus biotin transport, biotinidase and holocarboxylase defects, the biotin arm being what the confusables lack.

name: Islet insulin secretion with K-ATP channels and insulin processing
rationale: All members concern beta-cell hormone output (nutrient, incretin, neural and fatty-acid control of insulin and glucagon secretion), and the K-ATP/K2P channel and insulin processing/turnover members separate it from the incretin-receptor and insulin-action confusables.

core: Golgi nucleotide-sugar and substrate transporter deficiencies
name: Golgi nucleotide-sugar and substrate transporter deficiencies
rationale: Members are SLC35 nucleotide-sugar, SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA and SLC26A2 sulfate transporter defects plus nucleotide-sugar supply, unlike confusables centred on sugar biosynthesis, GPI or PAPS metabolism.

name: Rho-driven actin remodelling in cytokinesis and filopodia
rationale: Members share Rho/citron-controlled actin-septin cytoskeleton organisation, with contractile ring, cleavage furrow and filopodium regulation distinguishing it from dendritic and actin-filament-dynamics confusables.

core: Regulation of NF-kappaB transcription factor activity
name: Regulation of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity
rationale: All members regulate DNA-binding transcription factor activity, chiefly NF-kappaB canonical and non-canonical signalling, without the TLR/cytokine, TNFR1 or deubiquitinase content of the confusables.

name: Ear, gland, thymus and spleen organogenesis
rationale: Members are organogenesis terms for inner/middle/outer ear, exocrine and endocrine glands, thymus, spleen and taste papilla, whereas confusables cover craniofacial, limb or airway morphogenesis.

name: Inner ear development with hearing and balance sensation
rationale: Members cover ear morphogenesis and hair-cell fate together with auditory mechanotransduction, gravity sensing and vestibular reflexes, the sensory-function arm separating it from cranial-nerve, eye and stereocilia confusables.

name: Leak and calcium-activated potassium channels setting resting potential
rationale: Members are two-pore-domain (TWIK/TASK/TREK/THIK/TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with resting potential and hyperpolarisation control, unlike K-ATP, TALK/TRP or sodium-transport confusables.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members concern chromosome condensation, cohesin loading, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope breakdown/ESCRT resealing, the nuclear envelope arm distinguishing it from spindle, cohesion-resolution and meiosis confusables.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation and drug ADME
rationale: Members describe phase I/II metabolism of drugs, steroids and flavonoids (cytochromes, sulfonation, drug ADME), while confusables centre on xenobiotic transporters, bilirubin conjugation or mycotoxins.

name: SUMOylation of genome maintenance and nuclear envelope proteins
rationale: Members are SUMO modification of DNA replication, repair, nuclear envelope/Ran and SUMO/ubiquitin machinery targets, unlike confusables on SUMO processing or transcription factor and RNA-binding protein targets.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid, NKT activation
name: MHC class II and CD1-lipid antigen presentation with NKT activation
rationale: Members cover exogenous MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation with NKT cell regulation, distinguishing it from MHC class I cross-presentation and dendritic/monocyte surface-signature confusables.

name: DNA and histone lysine methylation, imprinting and X inactivation
rationale: Members are DNA/histone lysine methylation and demethylation machinery underlying imprinting, X inactivation and facultative heterochromatin, unlike arginine-methylation, NuRD/CHD or non-histone methylation confusables.

name: Sphingomyelin-derived ceramide and sphingolipid homeostasis regulation
rationale: Members regulate ceramide levels via sphingomyelin hydrolysis and feedback on sphingolipid synthesis, versus confusables on de novo sphingolipid biosynthesis, glycosphingolipids or lipid transfer.

name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and aminophospholipid flipping
rationale: Members concern non-vesicular phospholipid/glycolipid transfer between membranes and P4-ATPase aminophospholipid translocation, the flippase arm separating it from Rab, ER-tethering and phospholipid-catabolism confusables.

name: BMP-SMAD signalling in vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members pair BMP/SMAD signalling regulation with vessel formation, arterial/venous endothelial and vascular smooth muscle differentiation, distinguishing it from cardiomyocyte, conduction and valve development confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-mediated degradation of DNA damage checkpoint regulators
rationale: All three members are ubiquitin-proteasome turnover of checkpoint regulators (p53, Cdc25A, COP1), unlike confusables on G1/S RB-E2F or G2/M kinase checkpoint signalling.

name: NK receptor regulation of cytotoxicity and peripheral tolerance
rationale: Members concern KIR/NK receptor modules that tune NK and T cell cytotoxic activation and tolerance, the KIR cluster and tolerance terms separating it from costimulation and degranulation confusables.

core: Vitamin E, vitamin K and quinone metabolism
name: Vitamin E, vitamin K and quinone metabolism
rationale: Members are transport and metabolism of tocopherol, vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol/quinones, unlike confusables on cholesterol/mevalonate synthesis or gamma-carboxylation.

name: Mitochondrial translation, tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification
rationale: Members cover mitoribosome initiation-elongation-termination with tRNA charging and wobble-position modification for decoding, versus confusables on mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing and cytosolic tRNA processing.

core: Neural plate and dorsoventral axis patterning
name: Neural plate border specification and dorsoventral axis patterning
rationale: Members concern early neural plate formation, border/neural crest specification and dorsoventral axis and boundary determination, unlike confusables on axial mesoderm, floor plate or hindbrain segmentation.

name: Rho-family GTPase cycles in Arp2/3 lamellipodial protrusion and motility
rationale: Members are the Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles with Arp2/3-driven lamellipodia, ruffles, macropinocytosis and actin filament dynamics in migration, distinguishing it from cytokinesis/filopodia, ROCK/PAK and focal adhesion confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation
rationale: Members concern Pol II promoter escape, promoter-proximal pausing and elongation regulation, unlike confusables on HIV transcription, Pol I/III, termination or RNA processing.

name: FGFR3 activation and FGFR PI3K cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, mutant activation and adaptor cascades plus the PI3K arm of FGFR1-4, distinguishing it from FGFR1/2/4 SHC, FRS and PLC cascade confusables.

qualifier: activin control and Sertoli cell development
name: Activin-regulated gonadotropin secretion and Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members link activin/follistatin signalling and glycoprotein hormone FSH/LH secretion with Sertoli and seminiferous tubule development, the activin arm separating it from ovarian and Leydig/GnRH confusables.
